ICICI Prudential’s iProtect Smart Plus is one of the most feature-loaded term insurance plans available in India today — offering combinations of Critical Illness, Return of Premium, Smart Exit (ZERO-Cost Exit), and Premium Break options that few rivals match.
But does all this flexibility translate to real-world value? How does it compare with term plans from HDFC Life, Max Life or Bajaj Allianz — and is it really worth the premium you pay?

In this detailed Ditto review, we break down everything — plan structure, riders, benefits, claim stats, pricing — so you can decide if iProtect Smart Plus fits your life stage and financial goals.

💡 What We’ll Discuss in This Video:

→ Overview of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance — insurer profile, claim settlement ratio (98.03%), complaint volumes, and solvency metrics
→ Eligibility & entry age criteria (18 to 65 years) and premium payment options — Regular, Limited, Single Pay
→ Plan Variants explained: Life Option, Life Plus Option (Accidental Death Benefit), and Life Rebalancing Option
→ Built-in benefits — Terminal Illness Payout, Life Stage Protection (cover increase after marriage, childbirth, loan), Smart Exit (Zero-Cost Exit after 25 years / age 60), and Premium Break flexibility
→ Riders & Add-ons — Critical Illness (20 or 60 diseases), Accidental Death Rider, and future Waiver of Premium option
→ Claim experience and in-depth payout options (Lump Sum, Income, Lump Sum + Income, Increasing Income up to 145%)
→ Premium comparison across age profiles vs HDFC Life, Max Life, and Bajaj Allianz
→ Strengths, limitations, and ideal buyer profile for this plan
→ Our honest take — whether the flexibility justifies the pricing in 2025
